content.title: Calendar
content.summary: The city government offers a variety of environmental learning programs for all ages throughout the year, covering topics such as wildlife and conservation. Registration is required at least three days in advance, and programs may be canceled if minimum enrollment is not met. Refunds are available under specific conditions, including program cancellations or COVID-19 related issues.
content.body:
## Upcoming Public Programs

Our mission is to inspire environmental learning programs for all ages. This means we have programs year round that cover a wide range of topics, from learning about animals to conservation projects to simply connecting with the amazing things in nature. See all our upcoming programs on our calendar below, then make sure to register on our CivicRec site.

Please register at least three days in advance to allow instructors sufficient time to prepare. Classes that do not meet the minimum registration three days before their scheduled date may be canceled. Don’t hesitate – register today! All programs require pre-registration unless noted otherwise.

[Contact us](/1233) to submit a suggested program topic or [watch a walkthrough the registration process](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zbk_4PESFC8&t=158s).

## How To Register

View all upcoming programs and their descriptions on our calendar [on the registration site (CivicRec)](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog). Once you find a program you’d like to register for, or if you already know which program you’d like to join,  add the session to your cart to check out.  All programs require pre-registration. Have troubles registering, or need to pay day-of with cash or check? Please contact us to still pre-register over the phone at 720-898-7405 or [email us](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#6508040f0016110c06130c00120b06250417130401044b0a1702).

If you are having trouble creating your Civic Rec account, try some of these [troubleshooting instructions](https://www.civicrec.civicplus.help/hc/en-us/articles/4409526426007-Create-a-Public-Account) or visit the [Civic Rec help desk.](https://www.civicrec.civicplus.help/hc/en-us)

## Refund Policy

- A refund will be issued if requested no later than 3 business days prior to the start of the program, if minimum class size is met. Only a partial refund will be offered if the program has any physical costs (class/program materials and presenter costs).
  - Camp refund policy is listed on our camps page.
- A full refund will be issued if the program is canceled by Majestic View Nature Center.
- A refund will not be issued after a program has started.
- If you are unable to attend due to COVID-19, please contact us as soon as possible for a refund back to the card used to register. Refunds due to COVID-19 may not be issued after the program date. Participants should not attend if they do not feel well, have a fever of 100 degrees or higher, or have been in contact with a known COVID+ case.
